incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT for tenant corp-z — elevated 5xx rate (p95 latency unchanged). Affected: Redwood Dedicated pool 'eu-west-2-ded-42'. Paging on-call.
alex r: oncall here, acknowledging. pulling threads and starting triage. any immediate customer-facing impact? :eyes:
emily t: EM update: CSM pinged corp-z — they're seeing intermittent failures in their integration tests and a few production requests fail with 502s. They reported around ~30% of requests failing in last 10m.
priya s: I can't access corp-z traces in the tracing UI — looks like trace ingestion shows 0 spans for that tenant since 10:02z. logs-bot: note — tenant logs for corp-z are routed to a siloed GCP project (corp-z-logs-prod). Current incident-role doesn't have viewer perms there.
jamal k: checking serving metrics from the dedicated pool — node-level GPU/CPU look OK, but per-tenant request queue depth for corp-z is spiking on one router. Might be a routing partition.
alex r: hypothesis: routing partition causing retries -> backend 502s, but we also have an observability gap (no traces/logs) which blocks root cause. Need temporary mitigation and a plan to restore observability.
priya s: attempting to fetch raw logs via logs API. Trying:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" "https://logs.redwood.internal/api/v1/tenants/corp-z/logs?limit=100"
```

-> 403 Forbidden: project access denied. ops-bot: project corp-z-logs-prod has KMS policy that only allows customer-kms-bound roles; cross-team access blocked.
emily t: corp-z legal/compliance won't allow us to spin up a mirror copy of logs in another project. They asked that all access go through the corp-z-logs-prod project only.
jamal k: we can try a runtime mitigation to reduce failure surface: 1) route corp-z traffic to a compatible fallback model variant in a different pool (same region) 2) throttle burstiness via token bucket at the router to avoid queue overload. Can one of infra apply a temporary route? priya s: I can flip a routing rule to fallback model-7b-compat in ~4 minutes, that should reduce backend 502s if model variant is the issue.
alex r: do it, but document the change and be ready to revert. Also request temporary log-forwarding: if we can't access corp-z-logs-prod, can corp-z grant a short-lived service account to the oncall team? emily t: I just asked the CSM to request a one-hour service account with logs.viewer scoped to corp-z-logs-prod; corp-z says they can approve but need an explicit justification.
priya s: route change initiated — patch applied to router config: `route: tenant=c corp-z -> model_variant=model-7b-compat, pool=eu-west-2-ded-39` (rolling in progress). Monitoring.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: routing change rolled to 3/3 routers in pool (canaries passed).
jamal k: seeing immediate drop in 502s from 30% -> 8% over the last 90s. p95 lat still ok. queue depth falling. Good.
alex r: ephemeral step also: enabling request throttling at router level: `rate_limit: tenant=corp-z qps=20 burst=40` — applied. Observability needed though.
logs-bot: update from infra: cannot create cross-project SA due to corporate KMS boundaries without an audit ticket. Suggestion: grant read-only role to `redwood-observability-oncall@redwood-internal` in corp-z-logs-prod for 1 hour with audit log annotation.
emily t: corp-z is willing to grant an emergency read-only SA for 30m if we provide the audit ticket. I'm filing the approval request now and copying compliance.
priya s: while we wait I can scrape limited metrics from the pool-level metrics (not tenant-scoped) to validate stability. Starting a quick synthetic with corp-z's representative endpoint to confirm success rate.
alex r: good. also preparing customer communication: Emily, draft a brief note — we've applied a routing fallback and rate limits; impact reduced; we are requesting temporary log access to complete RCA. ETA for next update in 30m.
emily t: drafting now. will include action items and ETA. :writing_hand:
jamal k: note to postmortem: log-siloing + KMS policies create a hard observability blind during incidents; need a runbook addendum to request emergency read-only access and a fallback metric-exporter.
priya s: adding runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-observability-silo ; recommend adding a temporary sidecar forwarder in dedicated pools that can push aggregated tenant metrics to an ops-view project (requires customer opt-in).
alex r: handoff plan — I'm staying for 30m then handing to priya (primary) for sustained follow-up. priya, you'll coordinate with compliance/account to get the temp SA and finish RCA. If we get SA, priority: pull traces -> identify root cause -> revert fallback if safe.
priya s: ack. will update thread. current status: impact reduced, mitigation applied, waiting for temp SA. last check: 502 rate ~6% and trending down.
emily t: customer comms sent (cc CSM). corp-z acknowledges the change and is following up on the SA approval. they appreciate the quick mitigation.
alex r: thanks team. next update or final resolution will be posted here. tagging oncall rotation: @priya s you're the owner after 30m. :handshake:
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0429-87. severity: SEV2. tags: dedicated-pool, tenant-observability, corp-z.
